# TopGrade London FC

> Official Youth Football Club based in Tottenham, North London.

TopGrade London FC is a youth football club operating as a Community Interest Company (CIC) dedicated to technical player development, teamwork, and competitive youth football league play across North and East London.

## Legal Entity & Governance
- **Legal Name**: TOPGRADE LONDON FC CIC
- **Company Number**: 14087076 (Registered in England and Wales)
- **Registered Office**: 30 Broadwater Road, London, England, N17 6ES
- **Structure**: Community Interest Company (CIC)
- **Contact Email**: topgradelondonfc@hotmail.com

## Age Groups & Phases
- **Foundation Phase (U7 – U8)**: First touch, ball mastery, agility, and positive introduction to team football.
- **Skill Acquisition (U9 – U10)**: 1v1 attacking and defending, spatial awareness, passing range, and instinctive decision making.
- **Game Development (U11 – U12)**: Tactical positioning, transition play, set-pieces, and match tempo.
- **Youth Progression (U13 – U14)**: Tactical discipline, physical conditioning, and structured match mentoring.
- **Youth Competition (U15 – U16)**: Competitive league play, high-intensity game management, and senior pathway preparation.

## Training Schedule & Grounds
- **Tuesdays & Thursdays**: Frederick Knight Sports Centre (Tottenham Powerleague), Willoughby Lane, Tottenham, London N17 0RT (All-Weather 3G Floodlit Pitches)
  - U7 – U12: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM
  - U13 – U16: 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM
- **Wednesdays**: Tottenham Community Sports Centre, 701–703 High Road, London N17 8AD (Indoor Sports Hall & Technical Base)
  - U7 – U12: 5:30 PM – 7:00 PM
- **Matchday Venues**: Frederick Knight Sports Centre (Tottenham), Mabley Green (Hackney), and Hackney Marshes (Hackney).

## Safeguarding & Policies
TopGrade London FC operates under strict child safeguarding principles with emergency escalation procedures. The club complies with UK GDPR and child data protection requirements, strictly necessary cookie policies (no marketing trackers), and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility guidelines.
